event.initial_firm_notification: Two or more of the following: Email, Fax, Letter, Press Release, Telephone, Visit
event.distribution_pattern: Affected product was distributed to foodservice establishments in Omaha, Lincoln, and Bellevue, NE only.

products.product_description: Cabbage/nappa shredded, Label states "Joe's Pride" and bears the address 9705 I Street, Omaha, NE 68127. Product is packaged in poly bags inside cardboard boxes. All have a best by date of 7 days after the production date.
products.reason_for_recall: Routine environmental test samples were positive for Listeria monocytogenes on two processing machines.
